title: A cloud reinstall stops filling the skill list with backup copies
why: Build advisor finding, Oct 27 08:40 CDT: the cloud refresh hook moves each skill folder to <name>.bak.<time> before a fresh install, and each .bak folder lists as a skill: 11 more entries per install, 33 in one container.
note: Fix: skip the backup when the folder is our own install, or keep backups outside skills/. Red first on two installs in a row. Needs no answer. Port: no; it lives in claude-settings' installer. Placed ahead of c119 (triage, Oct 27): every long cloud session pays for it in its skill list.
